macros.name: emaillink
macros.doc: The \emaillink[⟨text⟩]{⟨link⟩} macro, analogously to komacv’s \emaillink macro, provides a means for typesetting a “mailto” link.

macros.name: httplink
macros.doc: The \httplink[⟨text⟩]{⟨link⟩} macro, analogously to komacv’s \httplink macro, provides a means for typesetting an HTTP link.

macros.name: httpslink
macros.doc: The \httpslink[⟨text⟩]{⟨link⟩} macro, analogously to komacv’s \httplink macro, provides a means for typesetting an HTTPS link.

macros.name: ifkomavar
macros.doc: The \ifkomavar{⟨name⟩}{⟨true-code⟩}{⟨false-code⟩} macro checks whether the KOMA variable ⟨name⟩ is defined and expands to ⟨true-code⟩ (positive case) or ⟨false-code⟩ (negative case) respectively.

macros.name: ifkomavarempty
macros.doc: The \ifkomavarempty{⟨name⟩}{⟨true-code⟩}{⟨false-code⟩} expands to ⟨true-code⟩ if the content of the KOMA variable ⟨name⟩ is empty, and expands to ⟨false-code⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: LoadLetterOption
macros.doc: The \LoadLetterOption{⟨name⟩} loads options from the file with filename ⟨name⟩ (an “lco”-file, but without the file extension).

macros.name: LoadLetterOptions
macros.doc: The \LoadLetterOptions{⟨names⟩} loads options from the files in the commaseparated list ⟨names⟩ of file names (again without “lco” extension).

macros.name: newkomavar
macros.doc: The \newkomavar[⟨description⟩]{⟨name⟩} macro defines a new KOMA variable with name ⟨name⟩ and description ⟨description⟩.

macros.name: setkomavar
macros.doc: The \setkomavar{⟨name⟩}[⟨description⟩]{⟨content⟩} macro sets the content of the variable with name ⟨name⟩ to content ⟨content⟩ and sets the description of the variable to ⟨description⟩.
